# `fec_election_workbook_rows`

**Official election workbook rows**

Official election workbook rows with exact source coordinates and explicit interpretation limits.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Literal official workbook rows, including summaries and overlapping appendices. Only the reviewed Senate layout is interpreted in the companion table. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fec_election_workbook_rows.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Deterministic identity of one native observation, bound to its source digest and coordinates. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original publisher bytes. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher URL recorded for the retained original; its current contents can differ. |
| `captured_at` | `VARCHAR` | Known original capture time; null where historical acquisition time is unknown. |
| `source_sheet` | `VARCHAR` | Literal worksheet name. |
| `reader_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version of the source reader over maintained literal workbook syntax. |
| `cells_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every literal cell on this workbook row, including nulls, cached formula values and presentation facts. |
| `source_row` | `INTEGER` | One-based native worksheet row, including source totals, notes and blanks. |
| `source_cycle` | `INTEGER` | Selected two-year FEC cycle or completed result edition. |
